title: Elderly Women Warming Hands by Campfire, 1950s Outdoor B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage mid-century black-and-white snapshot capturing two senior women bundled in winter coats outdoors on a chilly day, warming their hands over a smoking stone fire pit. One woman smiles in a light coat and headscarf, while her companion in glasses leans down closer to the embers in a dark heavy coat. A picnic bench and wooded field in the background suggest an autumn or spring outing at a park or rural campsite.
